chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"The beginning of the time is the pleasure of Allah, and its end is the forgiveness of Allah, and forgiveness only comes in the case of a sin."

key_terms.الْوَقْتِ: the prescribed time of the act, here the time for salat

ai.seo_question: Why is it better to perform salat at the beginning of its time?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the virtue of performing salat at the beginning of its prescribed time. It teaches that praying early is a cause of Allah's good pleasure, while delaying it until the end of its time is associated with seeking pardon for a shortcoming.
